support.fivem_installation: standard and custom paths; automatic discovery with interactive fallback
support.existing_plugins: isolated by default and restored transactionally
support.enhanced: not supported by v2 RC3; installer fails closed

modes.rp_visual: default launcher; standard signed ReShade + Main/Stream presets; no external ReShade add-ons
modes.full_neural: explicit launcher/Mode FullNeural; RTX 50-series + ReShade Full Add-on + SECRET EMKO-managed RenoDX/DLSS backends

support.multiplayer: server plugin policy applies; no Pure Mode, anti-cheat, server restriction or ReShade restriction bypass

renodx_framework.policy: latest upstream main at build time; exact SHA recorded in BUILD-MANIFEST.json

reshade.rp_visual: current official standard signed setup at install time
reshade.full_neural: current official Full Add-on setup at install time; explicit opt-in only

reshade_effects.policy: latest official packages required by shipped presets; unavailable external effects are disabled in installed presets

presets.note: Existing reshade-shaders content is migrated from the isolated old plugins folder; QuantV is never downloaded from unofficial mirrors.

dlss5_bridge.lifecycle: backend-only; cfg is live-reloaded upstream, SECRET EMKO schedules it not to load next start when Neural Rendering is off, and RC4 reports runtime delivery separately from file installation.
dlss5_bridge.reason: Pinned because the FiveM synthetic path needs the bridge's internal NVIDIA Optical Flow provider; stable 1.4.12 exposed the missing-motion-vector condition seen in the RC3 field log.

renodx_dlss5_consumer.lifecycle: file remains installed; SECRET EMKO soft-disables it at runtime and uses ReShade DisabledAddons so it is skipped on the next start when Neural Rendering is off

nvidia_dlss_sr.runtime_bootstrap: RC4 keeps the verified runtime in FiveM.app/plugins, preloads it by full path and, only for FiveM's disposable data/cache/subprocess host, creates a hardlink or copy beside the host executable so NGX can resolve the synthetic SuperSampling snippet without manual DLL placement.

nvidia_dlss_nr.hardware_policy: GeForce RTX 50 Series; unsupported hardware rejected unless expert ForceNeuralStack is supplied

secretemko_live_control.safety: exact size + SHA-256 + code fingerprints + ImGui dispatch identity; refuses unknown builds
secretemko_live_control.behavior: SECRET EMKO keeps verified RenoDX live control, exposes only three normal gaming looks (Natural/Cinematic/Detail) plus a realtime 0-2 strength control, and separates Frame Generation UI from provider readiness.
secretemko_live_control.provenance: MIT adapter derived from rakanki911/DLSS5-Swapper commit 24bd2aca7a7451ce94e564366381e33cac9dcdba

frame_generation.status: discovery_provider_built; fail-closed until shader-injected motion, HUD-less/UI and Streamline delivery are verified
frame_generation.production_motion_policy: shader-injected GTA/FiveM motion vectors required; Optical Flow is compatibility NR only and is mutually exclusive with native/shader-motion Frame Generation
frame_generation.coexistence: Neural Rendering and Frame Generation are not inherently exclusive. RC5 only forbids the synthetic Optical-Flow compatibility path from running together with Frame Generation. Shared NR+FG is allowed only after the provider reports a frame-aligned shared NR contract.
frame_generation.provider_readiness: UI unlock requires provider-reported frame-generation readiness plus shader motion, HUD-less color and UI readiness; file/module presence alone never unlocks 2x/3x.

reshade_content.fallback: online updater uses retry/backoff and curl.exe fallback if the bundled payload is missing
reshade_content.reason: RC5 field install saw transient GitHub 500/connection resets while downloading ReShade content; RC5.1 removes that runtime dependency for built Full Neural artifacts.
